outcome: birth in good condition (defined as presence of an infant heart rate >100 at five minutes of age)
cohort: 1722 singleton pregnancies in England in 2006 at 22-26 weeks of gestation where the fetus was alive at the start of labour monitoring or decision to perform caesarean section
finding: Antenatal steroids and tocolysis were associated with improved outcomes in extremely preterm babies, with variations in the effect of cesarean delivery according to gestational age and presence of spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: In women without spontaneous labour, Caesarean delivery at ≤24 and 25 weeks was associated with improved condition at birth and lower odds of DR death.
